question.text: Under SEBI Circular No. CIR/IMD/DF/14/2014 dated June 19, 2014, the Investment Manager of an AIF is required to file a Compliance Test Report (CTR) detailing compliance with AIF Regulations and circulars. The CTR is filed:

answer.text: At the end of every financial year
Only on demand by SEBI, no fixed frequency

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 11.7.2 and SEBI Circular dated June 19, 2014, the Compliance Test Report is filed by the investment manager at the end of every financial year, in the SEBI-prescribed format (included as Annexure to the Circular). This is separate from the quarterly investor reporting. The Trap: Monthly and quarterly are not CTR frequencies; they apply to different reports (e.g., SCORES, investor statements). Option D is incorrect — the CTR is mandatory and scheduled. Cross-Exam Context: Same annual-return concept tested in III-A (Compliance) and for mutual fund AMCs in XXI-A. Manager's Pro-Tip: Do not treat CTR as a 'year-end fire drill.' Run an internal CTR-style self-check quarterly — it surfaces compliance gaps (PPM deviation, reporting lapses) before they compound into a filing-day scramble.
